verdict.rationale: Open WebUI's docs state it chats with Ollama, OpenAI, Anthropic, or any OpenAI-compatible provider from a single interface, and lets you switch models mid-conversation while keeping context. Custom models or agents and coding agents show up as selectable entries in the model picker, and two models can run side-by-side. Missing for 10: Google and OpenRouter are not explicitly named as supported providers, per-agent model binding is only implied, and no independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power user, I can plug in multiple model providers — Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, OpenRouter, and more — and switch models per agent or per conversation

Talk to any model, switch mid-conversation, and keep your context intact.
